# EZO Watcher

> The open-source AI SRE for your project: agentic LiveOps monitoring that lives in your repo. An alert wall, a pager, and a `watcher` CLI whose install loop a coding agent runs end to end. Local by default; no account; config as code in `.watcher/`.

EZO Watcher watches a project's real telemetry points — a dependency-gated readiness route first, heartbeats for every scheduled job, then error trackers, metrics and inbound webhooks — and proves each check can go red before calling the install done.

Install (from GitHub; not yet on npm): `CI=1 npm_config_yes=true npm i -g --install-links github:ezolabs/ezo-watcher`. The one-prompt setup is in [README](README.md). The gate is `watcher doctor --live --prove --json` returning `{"ok": true, "live": true}`.

## Agent entry points

- [Skill: EZO Watcher](skills/ezo-watcher/SKILL.md): the install loop, the ranking, and the silence-first checklist — start here.
- [Install](skills/ezo-watcher/references/install.md): requirements, install paths, what `watcher init` writes, exit codes, upgrade.
- [Discover](skills/ezo-watcher/references/discover.md): the full signal catalogue, the six silence classes a scan misses, the readiness-route rule.
- [Sources](skills/ezo-watcher/references/sources.md): every source kind (`http-probe`, `tcp-probe`, `heartbeat`, `domain-expiry`, `host`, `feed`, `sentry`, `grafana`, `vmalert`, `netdata-cloud`, `netdata-fleet`, `webhook`), its config keys, flags and an example.
- [Channels](skills/ezo-watcher/references/channels.md): webhook, ntfy, email, SMS, web push, routes and escalation.
- [Hosting](skills/ezo-watcher/references/hosting.md): local → service → Docker/VPS → Cloudflare Tunnel → Containers (beta).
- [Cloudflare](skills/ezo-watcher/references/cloudflare.md): token permissions, `watcher cloudflare tunnel --hostname`, Access, failure codes.
- [Netdata](skills/ezo-watcher/references/netdata.md): the add-on, Cloud poll and webhook paths.
- [Fix](skills/ezo-watcher/references/fix.md): the fix loop — `get_fix_context`, repair, redeploy, `verify_fix` — and what "fixed" means per incident kind.
- [Operate](skills/ezo-watcher/references/operate.md): the 16 MCP tools, the stdio bridge and session hook, incident triage, re-check, keeping the Watcher alive.

## Repository rules

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to work in this repository — commands, layout, tests, the leak gate, commit style.
